meta.name: offensive-ssti
meta.description: Dense description covering Server-Side Template Injection across Jinja2, Twig, Freemarker, Velocity, Pebble, Smarty, Mako, Handlebars, ERB, Thymeleaf, EJS, Pug. Engine fingerprinting, filter bypass, blind exploitation, WAF evasion, SSTI-to-RCE chains. Tools: tplmap. CWE-1336. MITRE T1190. Use when testing template rendering endpoints or exploiting template injection for code execution.

copy.tagline: 挖掘并利用模板注入漏洞，获取服务器代码执行权限
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你是安全测试人员,需要检测和利用模板注入漏洞。
copy.tagline_en: Exploit template injection vulnerabilities to run code on servers.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're a security tester needing to detect and exploit template injection flaws.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会按这套方法处理服务端模板注入：先注入探测语句判断漏洞，再通过特征识别引擎类型，再生成针对该引擎的利用代码，可读取文件或执行命令；也涵盖盲测、过滤绕过和 WAF 绕过的写法。
howto.when: 当你要测试模板渲染接口是否存在注入，或已知注入点想进一步实现代码执行时，它会启动这套攻击流程。

say.text: 帮我测一下这个 URL 是否有 SSTI 漏洞。
say.note: Claude 会注入通用探测语句并观察回显。

say.text: 识别这个模板引擎，并用它读 /etc/passwd。
帮我绕过字符过滤执行 whoami。
say.note: Claude 会套用编码、参数走私等绕过技巧。

howto.what_en: Claude will guide SSTI testing: inject probes to confirm the flaw, fingerprint the engine (Jinja2, Twig, etc.), and provide engine-specific exploitation for file read or command execution, including blind detection, filter bypass, and WAF evasion.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you want to test template-rendering endpoints for injection or exploit a confirmed template injection to achieve code execution.

say_en.text: Help me test this URL for SSTI vulnerability.
say_en.note: Claude will inject probes and examine the response.

say_en.text: Identify the template engine and read /etc/passwd with it.
say_en.note: Claude fingerprints the engine and provides a file-read payload.

say_en.text: Help me bypass character filters to run whoami.
say_en.note: Claude applies encoding and parameter smuggling tricks.
